curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can two mobile cooks and an inept private eye outmaneuver real danger to keep an elusive pickpocket safe?
curatedMovie.description: In Sammo Kam-Bo Hung's action comedy, cousins Thomas and David run a mobile food van in Spain. Teaming up with their bumbling detective friend Moby, they jump into action to save Sylvia, an elusive pickpocket.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, lighthearted, and exciting; an engaging Hong Kong action caper that is great to share with friends.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: A breezy blend of martial arts action and slapstick comedy, this energetic caper pairs high-spirited rescue antics with warm, easy camaraderie.
